Created a Rust 2021 Cargo project in [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml) with the root entry file [test12.rs](/output/test12.rs) and library modules under [src/inflection](/output/src/inflection/mod.rs). The implementation is pure `std`, with `Inflector` methods in [inflector.rs](/output/src/inflection/inflector.rs), plural/singular helpers in [number.rs](/output/src/inflection/number.rs), and the case transforms in [case.rs](/output/src/inflection/case.rs).

It builds successfully with `cargo build --release`. The built binaries are [test12](/output/test12) and [target/release/test12](/output/target/release/test12). I verified the Rust binary against `/workspace/dataset/test12_executable` on the sample inputs plus edge cases like empty strings, repeated underscores, uppercase endings, and composition-order-sensitive cases, and the output matched byte-for-byte.
